jobs.title: Ticketing Manager
jobs.description: About Relevent Football Partners Relevent is the world’s leading privately owned commercial partner with a dedicated focus on international football. In 2025, UC3, the joint venture between UEFA and European Football Clubs, appointed Relevent as the exclusive sales and marketing organisation for UEFA’s flagship club competitions. It markets and sells media, sponsorship and licensing rights for the UEFA Champions League, UEFA Europa League and UEFA Conference League worldwide. Building on this partnership, UEFA has now also appointed Relevent to market and sell the media, sponsorship and licensing rights for UEFA National Team Football, covering the UEFA European Championship, UEFA Women’s EURO, the UEFA Nations League and the European Qualifiers. It is building a dedicated team to deliver this mandate in close partnership with UEFA, alongside its continuing work on the club competitions. Relevent is now seeking talented people to help build a truly world class business focused on the monetisation of UEFA’s club and national team competitions. Position Summary We are seeking a highly experienced ticketing professional to support the ticketing management and operational delivery of the UEFA Men’s Club Competitions commercial partner ticketing inventory across both the season and the Finals. This includes the UEFA Champions League (UCL), Europa League (UEL), Conference league (UCL) and the UEFA Super Cup. This is a total commercial inventory of over 250,000 tickets on an annual basis. This role is pivotal in ensuring a seamless, world‐class experience for UEFA Men’s Club Competitions commercial partners. Reporting directly to the Global Ticketing Lead, you will work collaboratively with internal teams, client stakeholders, technology providers, and external partners to oversee the end‐to‐end ticketing journey. This is a fast‐paced and high‐profile environment, requiring exceptional operational acumen, stakeholder management expertise, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. Reports to: Global Ticketing Lead Key Responsibilities Ticket Operations - Support day-to-day operations across the ticketing lifecycle. - Develop a comprehensive understanding of UEFA ticketing processes and systems. - Be the main Relevent Football Partners point of contact for commercial partners, UC3, and UEFA ticketing teams. - Deliver season and final ticketing operations including requests, deadlines, inventory management, block allocations and financial reconciliation. - Manage day-to-day queries with ticketing providers, suppliers and partners as required. - Document system workflows and user guides. - Execute the ticket allocation process in accordance with business priorities. - Administer internal ticketing systems and processes for day to day business. - Coordinate and deliver on-site matchday ticketing logistics for commercial partners, including mobile ticketing troubleshooting, will call, and box office supervision. - Deliver matchday operations & resolutions plan for commercial partner ticketing issues. - Resolve account and ticketing issues promptly, professionally, and with high attention to detail - Post‐event reporting. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration - Work cross-functionally with Media, Sponsorship & Licensing teams to manage commercial ticketing inventory, ensure project deadlines are met and ensure formal ticketing processes are adhered to. - Ensure all UEFA ticketing deadlines are met and ticket requests submitted in a timely manner by all stakeholders and partners. Experience required: - Proven track record of delivering ticketing programmes for major international sporting events – either from an agency or rights holder background. - Strong project management and people skills. - Exceptional stakeholder management and client communication skills. - Comprehensive knowledge and familiarity with event ticketing tools and guest management systems. Skills required: - Fluent use of English language in both verbal and written communications. - Exceptional project management, attention to detail, time management and organisational skills. - Adept at building strong relationships and delivering exceptional client service. - Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) showing confidence in engaging with internal and external stakeholders. - Creative problem solving with a strong sense of proactivity and ownership. Personal Attributes: - A passion for the difference sport makes around the world - The ability to build trusted, long-term relationships - A collaborative, low-ego approach and a willingness to help - High personal standards, with resourcefulness and tenacity - Clear, proactive communicator - A strong sense of ownership and urgency, with high levels of honesty and integrity Why Join Us At Relevent, you’ll be part of a passionate, global team committed to shaping the future of football in innovative and impactful ways. We offer a collaborative culture, exciting growth opportunities, and the chance to make a real difference in one of the world’s most beloved sports.

jobs.title: Hospitality and Events Manager
jobs.description: About Relevent Football Partners Relevent is the world’s leading privately owned commercial partner with a dedicated focus on international football. In 2025, UC3, the joint venture between UEFA and European Football Clubs, appointed Relevent as the exclusive sales and marketing organisation for UEFA’s flagship club competitions. It markets and sells media, sponsorship and licensing rights for the UEFA Champions League, UEFA Europa League and UEFA Conference League worldwide. Building on this partnership, UEFA has now also appointed Relevent to market and sell the media, sponsorship and licensing rights for UEFA National Team Football, covering the UEFA European Championship, UEFA Women’s EURO, the UEFA Nations League and the European Qualifiers. It is building a dedicated team to deliver this mandate in close partnership with UEFA, alongside its continuing work on the club competitions. Relevent is now seeking talented people to help build a truly world class business focused on the monetisation of UEFA’s club and national team competitions. Position Summary The Hospitality & Event Operations Manager will support the Relevent Football Partners Events & Hospitality team in delivering world-class commercial partner hospitality, with a primary focus on the UEFA Champions League (UCL) Final and support across the wider UEFA Men's Club Competitions (UMCC) Finals and other partner events. Acting as the key link between UEFA stakeholders, Partners and their agencies, the role manages day-to-day liaison between Partners and the UEFA Hospitality Production team, ensuring Partner Hospitality is delivered to the highest standard. Responsibilities include project management, partner documentation, supplier and agency management, and stakeholder engagement. Reports to: Senior Manager, Hospitality & Events Key Responsibilities Pre Event Project Management - Primary contact for the UEFA Hospitality Production team and commercial Partners on Partner Hospitality at the UCL Final, including the ‘Champions Village’ and other Relevent events. - Lead project documentation (plans, trackers, status and briefing documents) to ensure all deadlines are met. - Manage concise, co-ordinated Partner communications on hospitality orders, operations and experience. - Coordinate and approve Partner Hospitality concepts with UEFA Hospitality, including brand visibility and activation plans. - Maintain Partner-facing documents and platforms, including the Partner Options Catalogue (POC) for ordering hospitality items. - Work with departments to manage Sponsor Hospitality online tools and systems, streamlining processes for Sponsors and agencies. Site Visits - Lead Partner Site Visits, co-creating presentations with UEFA Hospitality Production. - Manage all Partner topics, including 1:1 meetings, agendas and logistics. - Lead post site visit follow ups and actions. Foster collaboration with UC3, UEFA and Relevent Football Partners teams, Partners, agencies and suppliers. - Plan and attend other venue or city visits as required. Onsite Delivery - Oversee Partner Hospitality delivery at the UCL Final, including the Champions Village and UEFA Club, and support delivery at other UMCC Finals. - Primary on-site contact for Partners and agencies from set-up onwards, resolving queries and issues. - Manage clear, efficient communication channels with Partner operational contacts and agencies. - Lead daily Partner meetings and tours to track implementation against agreed timelines and plans. - Monitor and sign off Partner creative concept implementation. - Full involvement in match-day operations, including guest flow, VIP escorting and real-time issue resolution. General - Proactively identify and implement improvements to team processes, workflow and productivity. - Collaborate with the wider events, hospitality and ticketing team, agencies and suppliers to deliver consistent, high-quality partner experiences. - Build strong relationships with UC3, UEFA and Relevent Football Partners Sponsorship and Media teams, acting as the single point of truth for UMCC Finals Partner Hospitality. - Support the wider team across other partner events, including the UEL and UECL Finals, UCL Draw, UEFA Super Cup, season hospitality, partner workshops and Relevent corporate events. Experience required - Extensive experience delivering large-scale Partner hospitality at global live sports events. - UEFA event experience desirable but not essential. - Strong understanding of hospitality delivery requirements and commercial partner contractual rights. - Proven track record in client servicing, operational planning and end-to-end hospitality delivery. - Proven ability to manage budgets, contracts and suppliers. - Familiarity with online ticketing tools and guest management systems. - Skilled at coordinating multiple stakeholders in complex, high-pressure environments. Skills required - Exceptional project management, attention to detail and organisational skills. - Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills. - Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. - Excellent written and verbal communication, confident, engaging senior leadership and VIP Partners. - Creative problem-solving and a strong sense of proactivity and ownership. - Proficient in PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with AI, CRM, guest management and project management tools is a plus. Personal Attributes - A passion for the difference sport makes around the world - The ability to build trusted, long-term relationships - A collaborative, low-ego approach and a willingness to help - High personal standards, with resourcefulness and tenacity - Clear, proactive communicator - A strong sense of ownership and urgency, with high levels of honesty and integrity - Willingness to travel and work occasional evenings/weekends for events. Why Join Us At Relevent, you’ll be part of a passionate, global team committed to shaping the future of football in innovative and impactful ways. We offer a collaborative culture, exciting growth opportunities, and the chance to make a real difference in one of the world’s most beloved sports.

jobs.title: Manager, Hospitality (UK-External Agency Position)
jobs.description: The Manager, Hospitality (UK) will play a key role in the planning, delivery, and execution of NFL Premium and VIP Hospitality programs for the NFL's international games and events. This individual will oversee guest experiences, ensuring best-in-class service for NFL partners, clients, and fans while helping deliver exceptional hospitality experiences that reflect the NFL brand. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners, the Hospitality Manager will lead and support hospitality initiatives before, during, and after international events throughout the year. The role requires strong organizational, project management, and communication skills, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and solutions-focused, with a passion for creating memorable experiences and a willingness to go above and beyond to deliver outstanding results. This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment are handled by the agency. The assignment to provide services to the NFL will be limited in duration but may be extended for an additional period by agreement between the NFL and the agency. Key Responsibilities: Design and planning of all hospitality areas including suites, shared spaces, and NFL VIP for international games Manage sales and event agencies to deliver a high-end hospitality program Work collaboratively with participating teams in their hospitality delivery Assist in the branding and design for all hospitality and customer facing areas Conduit between contractors and NFL Creative Day-to-day lead for stadium catering; assist in the creation of menus for GA/Hospitality areas May include external events Entertainment programming Cross department guest list management alongside NFL Ticketing and Global Hospitality sales team Working closely with the NFL’s Elite Service, management of internal clients, teams, NFL Executives and team ownership Support in the execution of and delivery of the NFL international games Lead or support in external partner events throughout the year Technical Experience and Role Requirements: Minimum of 5 years’ working within sports and event industry Working within stadiums is highly desired Experience in managing and executing multiple events Outstanding stakeholder management Excellent time management, problem solving and organisational skills Proficiency in MD Office (PPT, Word, Excell etc.) and excellent email management skill required Strong communication, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and work well under pressure to meet deadlines Proactive mindset and professional manner to align with business objectives, customer expectations and brand values Proficiency in English required, other languages encouraged Awareness of cultural differences and inclusion Willingness and availability to travel to local and international games (primarily Europe) Personal Attributes: A genuine passion for delivering exceptional customer service and experiences Excellent attention to detail Willingness to travel, work long hours and weekends when required Interest in sports recommended Terms / Expected Hours of Work Requires extensive travel to event locations across the UK and Europe. Requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends and holidays, particularly during event and game weeks.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Supervisor
jobs.description: Most companies claim to have the best people. We say to them, "Keep dreaming." Our people are second to none. They set us apart with their entrepreneurial spirit and ambition. They come to us from the likes of Amazon, Microsoft, Nordstrom, Starbucks and the sports world, bringing energy, bold ideas and a willingness to dive into the unfamiliar. It's our people that make BDA the top global Merchandise Agency to work for. The Sales Operations Supervisor plays a critical role in driving operational excellence within the Sales Operations team. This position ensures the efficiency, accuracy, and consistency of processes while acting as a key partner to Sales Operations and Sales Leaders. A person in this role must be proactive in identifying process improvements, skilled in data-driven decision-making, and committed to coaching and developing a high-performing team. The ideal person in this role thrives in a fast-paced environment, effectively manages multiple priorities, and is confident in providing mentorship, performance feedback, and strategic direction to their team of coordinators. They bring a growth mindset, a solution-focused approach, and a strong sense of professional maturity, ensuring their team continuously improves and adapts to the evolving needs of the business. LOCATION: This role is based in Luton, UK. During the six-month probationary period, successful candidates are expected to work onsite 5 days per week . Following probation, the role offers a flexible hybrid schedule of 4 days per week in the office and one day working remotely. To be considered, applicants must reside within a reasonable commuting distance of Luton, as regular in-person collaboration is an important aspect of the position. Duties and responsibilities Operational Leadership & Process Optimization Oversee daily operations of the sales Operations team to ensure optimal resource utilization and adherence to BDA policies and procedures. Drive process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and overall team performance. Utilize reporting platforms to analyze trends, assess workload distribution, and support business objectives with data-driven insights. Act as the primary point of contact for communication with Account Managers and assigned Operations teams, ensuring seamless collaboration. Maintain strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks effectively while ensuring timely execution. Team Development & Performance Management Provide continuous coaching, mentorship, and performance feedback to ensure the team meets and exceeds expectations. Conduct performance evaluations and set clear, measurable goals aligned with company objectives. Foster a culture of accountability by clearly defining KPIs and holding employees responsible for their performance. Act as a problem solver, proactively identifying workload challenges, interpersonal conflicts, or performance concerns and addressing them appropriately. Develop employees by encouraging a growth mindset and commitment to ongoing professional development. Collaboration & Strategic Execution Partner with Sales Leaders to align Sales Operations strategies with overall business goals. Support Operations Leadership in the execution of Wildly Important Goals (WIGs) and company initiatives. Serve as a backup resource to assist coordinators when necessary, ensuring smooth team operations. Adapt quickly to changes and shifting priorities, demonstrating an ability to embrace change and guide the team through transitions. Job Skills and Traits Required Behaviors & Attributes Growth Mindset: Demonstrates a continuous desire to learn, grow, and take initiative. Actively seeks opportunities to develop new skills and progress within the company. Solution Focused: Approaches challenges with a positive mindset and proactively resolves issues. Deals effectively with conflict while assuming positive intent from others. Professional Maturity: Acts as a self-starter who is respectful, transparent, and cooperative. Maintains professionalism and accountability in all interactions. Adaptable to Embrace Change: Adjusts quickly to shifting priorities and thrives in a fast-paced environment by embracing new processes and challenges. Core Skills & Experience Time Management & Ability to Prioritize: Effectively plans and executes tasks while meeting deadlines. Demonstrates an ability to juggle multiple priorities without compromising quality. Organized: Maintains a structured approach to work, ensuring clear and systematic documentation and process management. Quality of Work & Attention to Detail: Consistently delivers thorough and accurate work that meets high standards. Critical for managing complex order processes and ensuring seamless execution. Customer Service Oriented: Prioritizes customer satisfaction by understanding and addressing the needs of both internal teams and external clients. Demonstrates empathy, clear communication, and prompt resolution of issues. Technical Proficiency: Proficient in using industry tools such as Salesforce and Microsoft Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams), along with other relevant software for efficient order management, data analysis, and reporting. Sales Oriented: Possesses the ability to influence decisions and negotiate effectively, even within an operational role. Demonstrates a mindset geared toward driving results and contributing to overall sales objectives. Experience Requirements 1-2 years of experience in Sales Operations or a similar role. 1-2 years of leadership experience managing a team of three or more employees. Experience with CRM and ERP systems (Salesforce and Oracle E-Business Suite preferred but not required). We are pleased to share the base salary range for this position is £46,000 to £48,000. If you are hired at BDA, your compensation will be determined by factors such as skills, education, and experience, while also taking internal equity and pay fairness into account. In the spirit of transparency, the range listed represents the full base salary range for the role, with starting salaries typically set within this range to allow room for growth over time. #LI-Onsite #LI-RB1 BDA is more than a workplace - it’s a family. For more than four decades we’ve promoted a vibrant and welcoming culture that not only accepts but demands you to be different. The quirky, the bold, the creative and the unique make up the foundation of a company that the most iconic brands in the world look to help tell their story through the power of merchandise. BDA Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Connect With Us! Not ready to apply? Connect with us for general consideration. For more information: www.bdainc.com For information about BDA's privacy policy for job applicants click here . Must be 18 years or older to apply.

jobs.description: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Dubai Events Community Manager who is trustworthy, self-driven, motivated, and accountable to join our Global Experiential Marketing team. The ideal candidate is a natural relationship-builder who thrives on turning event moments into lasting community connections across MENA's games industry, anchored by activity at the Xsolla Club in Dubai. You will use your community management, content, and relationship-building skills to grow and nurture Xsolla's network of partners, developers and clients in the region, working closely with the Dubai events team, Social Media Manager, and Marketing colleagues. The right person for this role will be personable, organized, and confident engaging senior industry stakeholders, with a strong instinct for the kind of content and touchpoints that keep a community engaged between events. This role is in-office/on-site at Xsolla's new Dubai Club and will require occasional regional travel for events. ABOUT US Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game. For more information, visit xsolla.com. Longevity Opportunity Vision — Enjoy the game!

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Event Operations, UK (External Agency Position)
jobs.description: The NFL Event Operations team is seeking an experienced and highly organized Senior Manager of Event Operations to lead the planning, overlay and delivery of NFL International Games across the UK and Europe. Reporting to the Director of Event Operations, this role will provide senior operational leadership from initial planning and stadium overlay through to Gameday delivery and post-event assessment. The role will lead an event operations team and work closely with stadium and city partners, NFL clubs, vendors and a broad range of stakeholders to deliver world-class NFL games in Europe. The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of complex live-event environments, exceptional project management skills and the ability to lead confidently in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment. The role will be primarily based at the NFL UK offices in London, with relocation to host stadiums during game weeks. Frequent international travel, as well as evening and weekend work will be required. This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team, with responsibility for high-profile International Games in Europe and opportunities to contribute to the wider portfolio of NFL League events. This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment are handled by the agency. The assignment to provide services to the NFL will be limited in duration but may be extended for an additional period by agreement between the NFL and the agency. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Serve as a senior operational lead on site, providing direction and making real-time decisions throughout planning, event build, Gameday and load out. Lead the development and delivery of comprehensive operational overlay plans for NFL International Games at host stadiums. Lead stadium transformation, construction and conversion planning, ensuring all requirements are delivered safely, efficiently and to the required NFL standard. Develop and manage detailed operational plans, master schedules, construction timelines and event readiness documentation. Lead coordination across all internal and external stakeholders, including stadium and city partners, Ticketing, Broadcast, Football Operations, Game Presentation, Security, Marketing, Partnerships and other relevant functions. Lead the management and delivery of third-party vendors, including contract deliverables, operational requirements and on-site performance. Manage the stadium operations budget, including forecasting, cost control, purchase orders and payments. Provide clear operational leadership and decision-making throughout game week, proactively identifying and resolving issues and escalating critical matters where appropriate. Support the planning and delivery of sponsor and partner activations within the wider event environment. Ensure appropriate health, safety and operational compliance standards are maintained throughout planning, build and event delivery. Work closely with relevant stakeholders to develop and implement contingency and risk-management plans. Lead post-event debriefs, assessments and reporting, identifying lessons learned and opportunities for continuous improvement. Contribute to the development of operational best practices, processes and standards for future International Games and wider NFL events. Experience & Qualifications Extensive knowledge and proven experience planning and delivering complex, large-scale live events. Educated to degree or equivalent professional experience. 8+ years' experience working within a stadium, venue, live events or comparable operational environment. Demonstrated experience within professional sports, entertainment, major events or complex project planning and delivery. Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders and competing priorities. Proven experience leading and developing an operational delivery team. Experience managing external vendors, contractors and commercial partners. Strong understanding of stadium operations, event overlay, event infrastructure and live-event logistics. Experience operating in an international or multi-market environment is desirable. Knowledge or understanding of American Football and the NFL is desirable. Leadership Attributes The successful candidate will demonstrate: Exceptional organization and time management, with the ability to prioritize effectively and consistently deliver against critical deadlines. Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate issues, develop solutions and make confident decisions in high-pressure environments. The ability to manage upwards , provide clear recommendations and communicate effectively with senior leaders. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build alignment and drive collaboration across multiple teams and functions. Strong presentation skills, with the confidence to communicate operational plans, risks and key decisions to large audiences and senior stakeholders. Adaptability and resilience, with the ability to remain calm, focused and solutions-oriented in a constantly changing live-event environment. Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate and build trusted relationships with internal colleagues, stadium and city partners, vendors and other external stakeholders. A collaborative leadership style, with the ability to motivate teams, create accountability and bring people together around a common goal. High levels of integrity, professionalism and personal accountability. An enthusiastic, proactive and positive approach, with a genuine commitment to delivering the highest standards of operational excellence. People Management Proven experience managing and leading a team of at least three direct reports or equivalent operational resources . Ability to provide clear direction, priorities and communication throughout complex event planning and delivery. Demonstrated track record of coaching, developing and supporting team members to achieve their full potential. Ability to build a high-performing team culture based on accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement. Terms / Expected Hours of Work Requires extensive travel to host stadiums and other event locations across the UK and Europe. Requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends and holidays, particularly during event and game weeks.
